title: A/A control: identical strength, jittered budgets
description: Both sides have the same expected strength: the same options and an average budget of 10,000 nodes, with each move's budget randomly varied by up to 10% (seeded). Fixed-node Stockfish is deterministic, so without the jitter identical engines would replay mirrored games and the control would prove nothing. A sound harness must report a score near 50%; a large gap would reveal a bias in colours, openings or scoring.
hypothesis: Score is 50% and the Elo interval includes zero.
